Tah Veḥartanu le-Yom haSgidah, an adaptation of the fourth berakhah of the Sigd festival musaf — by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:bibl.tei:title: תָּה בְחַרְתָּֽנוּ לְיוֹם הַסְּגִידָה
Tah Veḥartanu le-Yom haSgidah, an adaptation of the fourth berakhah of the Sigd festival musaf — by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
tei:bibl.tei:author: Isaac Gantwerk Mayer
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: An adaptation of the fourth berakhah of a festival musaf for Sigd. One technical note: as there is technically no Sigd musaf in the liturgical framework historically established within the halkhah of rabbinic Judaism, this berakhah does not end with shem u-malkhut in the ḥatimah.

Note: “The CAUSE” is used to translate the Divine Name YHVH, based on the philosophical idea of God as the Prime Mover and on the interpretation of the Name as a causative form of the copula – “causes to be.” “God” is used to translate the divine name Elohim. All divine referents (pronouns, epithets, names) are rendered in unicase.
